question: The Rajya Sabha seat distribution among states is found in which Schedule of the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Fourth Schedule**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Fourth Schedule** of the Indian Constitution deals with the **allocation of seats** in the **Rajya Sabha**, the upper house of Parliament.
 
• The allocation of seats is based on the **population of the respective states and union territories**.
 
• The Rajya Sabha currently consists of **250 members**, including representatives of the states, union territories, and nominated members.
 
• The Fourth Schedule ensures that the representation in the Rajya Sabha is **equitable and proportional** to the population of each state.
 
• This schedule was adopted in 1950 and has been amended several times to reflect the changes in population as per the **Census**.
 
• It provides for the division of seats among states and union territories, including changes made through **constitutional amendments**.
 
• The Fourth Schedule is crucial for maintaining the balance of representation in the federal structure of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tenth Schedule**__

 __
 
• The **Tenth Schedule** of the Indian Constitution deals with the **anti-defection law**.
 
• This schedule was added to the Constitution through the **52nd Amendment Act of 1985**.
 
• It lays down provisions for disqualification of members of Parliament or State Legislatures on the grounds of **defection**.
 
• The law aims to prevent **political instability** caused by elected members switching parties.
 
 
 
• **Second Schedule**__
 __
 
• The **Second Schedule** deals with the **emoluments, allowances, and privileges** of several constitutional functionaries.
 
• It includes provisions for the **President, Governors, Judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts, Speaker, Deputy Speaker**, and others.
 
• This schedule ensures uniformity and transparency in the **salaries and benefits** of these functionaries.
 
 
 
• **First Schedule**__
 
 
• The **First Schedule** specifies the **states and union territories** of India.
 
• It also contains details about the **territorial extent** of each state and union territory.
 
• This schedule is important for understanding the **geographical and administrative divisions** of India.
